note: Same ~40 s Benny script for every voice option. Each line names the delivery profile it tests.

lines.text: Okay, so here's how it works. In Japan, everything costs thousands. Thousands! So the yen must be super valuable.
...What? Why are you doing the eyebrow?
So I've been bragging about being rich... in pennies.
Okay, but they're very nice pennies. Some of them have holes in them!
Don't tell the chef. I tried to tip him with them.
Wait, wait, wait. So Japan is on sale? Like, the whole country?
Alright. When the dollar gets stronger, every dollar turns into more yen. That part I actually get.
See? I know things. Write that down.
